svg.title: Compositional score sampling and local feasibility pruning pipeline
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of a multi-stage sampling pipeline. Top frame contains batch initialization, clean-sample prediction, local feasibility metric, pruning, elite/repopulate batches, arrows and ellipses. Bottom-left frame explains compositional score sampling for global coherence with diffusion blocks, bars, equations, resampling loop and magnifier connector. Bottom-right frame explains local feasibility metric with DDIM inversion for pruning, image strips, labels, DDIM block, gradient bars, distribution and objective formula. Right supplementary frame contains an abstract vertical landscape sample.

g.desc: Origin is the left normal distribution feeding initial batch τ(T). The flow proceeds rightward through batch τ(t), batch τ(t−1), predicted clean samples, local feasibility metric J(·), min J(·) selection, elite batch, repopulate batch and final landscape. The top section is a left-to-right procedural symmetry with repeated three-row batch stacks.

Blue frame inventory: title, τ(t) and τ(t−1) vertical gradient bars, colored brackets and labels y1(t), y3(t), y3(t), local plan diffusion model, three score equations, two pixel score strips, plus combination node, denoising diffusion box, resampling loop arrow. Arrangement is roughly horizontal and symmetric around the score-composition node.
g.text: Compositional Score Sampling for Global Coherence

g.desc: Yellow frame inventory: title, τ(0) clean-sample column with three image crops and colored brackets, labels y1(0), y3(0), y3(0), ellipses, intermediate y(i−1) image samples, DDIM inversion block, y(i) labels, gradient score strip, dotted continuation, gray τ(T) noise strip and normal distribution. The section is a temporal left-to-right chain with three repeated rows and a bottom objective formula.
g.text: Local feasibility metric with DDIM Inversion for Pruning

g.desc: Abstract vertical generated clean sample at the far right: a tall landscape with orange cliffs, blue sky/water, clouds and green mountains, matching the final sample crop position.
